methodology.intrabar_collision: stop assumed first when stop and target both touched
methodology.selection_policy: rank on selection only; freeze top 109; holdout may reject but never replace
methodology.anti_lookahead: for every executable strategy, compare full-history pre-cut signals with prefix-only signals
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided positive-edge p-values with Benjamini-Hochberg q<=0.10 required before ranking
methodology.holdout_confirmation: frozen selection winners must independently pass positive-edge p<=0.10 on untouched holdout; holdout cannot promote replacements
